title: Pause, suspend, or revoke?

scenes.heading: An incident starts during a rollout
voice: An incident starts while Argo CD is applying a GPU stack change.
Decide whether to hold new rollout steps, suspend automated sync, or end the rollout.
scenes.result: Choose the scope of the freeze

scenes.heading: Pause holds new Operator steps
scenes.sub: Automated Argo CD repair keeps running.
voice: Pause holds the Operator at the next step boundary.
Argo CD can finish an in-flight sync and continues automated sync and drift repair, so a pause fits a rollout maintenance freeze.

scenes.heading: Suspend the deployment engine
scenes.sub: Automated sync and drift repair stop.
voice: Suspend the engine when you need to hold automated sync and drift repair too.
The Operator disables automated sync for its Applications, while a sync that already started can finish.

scenes.heading: Revoke to withdraw approval
scenes.sub: The rollout ends after its current step.
voice: Revoking approval lets the current step finish and ends the rollout.
Starting again takes a new rollout and fresh approval, so the team can review the state first.

payoff: Choose between holding new Operator steps, stopping automated Argo CD sync, and ending the rollout.
